title: Glyphite Showcase
tagline: The engine running live on the public landing page: a word in rock, sand, lamps and meteors
description: Unlisted. Shown at the top of the landing page that visitors see before they log in. GLYPHITE is spelled in rock on the ground, lit by a low sun and two lamps; sand pours onto it and meteors break it into falling chunks. Click or tap to drop a meteor. When the word is mostly gone it builds itself again.

meteorEvery.label: Meteor every
meteorEvery.help: How often a meteor falls by itself (clicks drop more).

sand.label: Sand
sand.help: How much sand pours from the hoppers above the word.
